note: People born in the US Virgin Islands are citizens of the United States (8 U.S.C. 1406(b)), and the islands are part of the United States for the nationality law (8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38)), so its rules are the United States'.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1406 Persons living in and born in the Virgin Islands
sources.said: (b) All persons born in the Virgin Islands of the United States on or after January 17, 1917, and prior to February 25, 1927, and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States are declared to be citizens of the United States at birth.ens of the United States as of February 25, 1927; and all persons born in those islands on or after February 25, 1927, and subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, are declared to be citizens of the United States at birth.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1101 Definitions
sources.said: (29) The term "outlying possessions of the United States" means American Samoa and Swains Island. ... (38) The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.
